skills.description: Kỹ năng hiện tại trên Wiki ở Rank 0; bản dịch tác dụng đang cập nhật. Xem phần đối chiếu để đọc cơ chế gốc.
skills.officialDescription: Deals damage based on your weapon damage. Each of your skills gets an additional benefit from hourglasses and corruption you equip in your consumables slot. Hourglasses and corruption can be obtained from the Hourglass Pet available from the Book of Lore.
wikiNotes: If Infinite Corruption is active, applies Infinity Rend for 40 seconds, a DoT that stacks to 15.
If Timepiece of Madness is active, applies the following effects:
Applies one stack of Mad for every use of Corrupted Sand Strike.
At 5 stacks of Mad, the next Corrupted Sand Strike consumes these stacks and applies Eternal.
Eternal boosts your critical strike chance by 80% and reduces the damage you deal by 30%.

skills.name: Corruption Through Time
skills.description: Kỹ năng hiện tại trên Wiki ở Rank 3; bản dịch tác dụng đang cập nhật. Xem phần đối chiếu để đọc cơ chế gốc.
skills.officialDescription: Applies Corruption Through Time. Corruption Through Time increases all damage you do by 20% for 10 seconds. Doesn’t stack.
wikiNotes: If Entropic Corruption is active, applies the following effects:
Entropic Harm for 10 seconds, increasing damage taken by 150%.
Entropic Mana for 7 seconds, increasing haste by 30% and reducing mana costs by 50%.
Entropic Power for 4 seconds, increasing damage by 100%.
Focus for 3 seconds, forcing affected monsters to attack you.
If Foresee Corruption is active, applies the following effects:
Foresee for 150 seconds.
Using Foresee Corruption again replaces this effect with Seer for 20 seconds.
Using Corruption Through Time again replaces Seer with Change the Future.
Change the Future applies Focus to enemies, and decreases damage taken by 500%, and increases dodge chance, haste, hit chance, damage, and crit damage by 100% for 5 seconds.
If Hourglass of Paradise is active, applies the following effects (or removes them if they are currently active):
Welcome to Paradise, reducing damage taken by 60% and increasing haste by 50%. In addition, provides a Heal over Time that also regenerates mana. Lasts 2 hours.
Price of Paradise, reducing crit chance and outgoing damage by 30%. Lasts 2 hours.
If Hourglass of Transience is active, applies the following effects:
Transient for 10 seconds, a self DoT that increases in strength.
Using Corruption Through Time again replaces Transient with Ephemeral for 5 seconds, increasing dodge and damage by +50%.
If Timepiece of Madness is active, applies the following effects:
Applies Potential, increasing your Hit Chance by 20% for 20 seconds. Cooldown: 12 seconds.
If Timepiece of Inevitability is active, applies the following effects:
Applies Inevitable Corruption, increasing your outgoing damage and haste by 12% for 20 seconds.
Using the Timepiece of Inevitability while Inevitable Corruption is active applies Snap to your opponent, dealing significant damage to them after a short delay. Cooldown: 20 seconds.
If Timepiece of Pestilence is active, applies the following effects:
Applies Infectious Air, increasing the amount of damage the enemy takes by 20% for 10 seconds, stacking to 3 but is consumed by Temporal Collapse.
Your incoming damage is increased by 100% for 10 seconds.
Applies a light DoT to your opponent.
Applies Decay to your opponent, preventing them from healing.

effects.text: Corruption Through Time tăng 20% mọi sát thương gây ra trong 10 giây, không cộng dồn.
Entropic Corruption áp Entropic Harm, tăng 150% sát thương nhận vào trong 10 giây. Entropic Mana tăng 30% Haste và giảm 50% Mana Cost trong 7 giây. Entropic Power tăng 100% sát thương trong 4 giây.
Với Entropic Corruption, Focus ép quái chịu tác động đánh người thi triển trong 3 giây.

Foresee Corruption áp Foresee trong 150 giây. Dùng lại Foresee Corruption chuyển thành Seer trong 20 giây. Dùng lại Corruption Through Time thay Seer bằng Change the Future trong 5 giây, giảm 500% sát thương nhận vào và tăng 100% Dodge, Haste, Hit Chance, sát thương và Crit Damage.
Change the Future áp Focus.

Hourglass of Paradise bật hoặc tắt Welcome to Paradise và Price of Paradise. Trong 2 giờ, Welcome giảm 60% sát thương nhận vào, tăng 50% Haste và hồi HP lẫn Mana theo thời gian. Price giảm 30% Crit Chance và sát thương gây ra.
Hourglass of Transience áp Transient, DoT tự gây tăng dần trong 10 giây. Dùng lại kỹ năng thay Transient bằng Ephemeral, tăng 50% Dodge và sát thương trong 5 giây.
Timepiece of Madness áp Potential, tăng 20% Hit Chance trong 20 giây, hồi chiêu hiệu ứng 12 giây.
Timepiece of Inevitability áp Inevitable Corruption, tăng 12% sát thương gây ra và Haste trong 20 giây.
Dùng Timepiece of Inevitability khi Inevitable Corruption hoạt động áp Snap, gây sát thương lớn sau một khoảng trễ. Hồi chiêu hiệu ứng 20 giây.
Timepiece of Pestilence áp Infectious Air, tăng 20% sát thương mục tiêu nhận trong 10 giây, tối đa 3 stack, bị tiêu hao bởi Temporal Collapse. Áp thêm DoT nhẹ và Decay.
Timepiece of Pestilence tăng 100% sát thương nhận vào trong 10 giây.
